spacecraft_spk.comments:
Created by Monte 166.1 on 2023/12/13 23:53 UTC.

This SPK is a reconstruction of the Psyche spacecraft trajectory
Produced by the Psyche Mission Design and Navigation team at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory

Email contact: psyche.mdnav@jpl.nasa.gov

limitations: No subsecond SECO-2 telemetry or SPK state covariance is provided.
The launch SPK starts after SECO-2; cutoff cannot be detected from this SPK.
C3 and asymptotes are Earth two-body osculating quantities; their time variation is not automatically numerical error.
No Earth SOI crossing or optimisation was performed in this stage.
